g.text: Supp. Fig. 11: Composite patterns are placed between their constituent patterns.

text.style: font: 7.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Every pairwise combination of six patterns was simulated in the same cell (40,971 held-out observations over 15 pairs) and embedded with the

text.style: font: 7.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: published model alongside 48,370 pure held-out observations; all comparisons are made within spot-count deciles. (a) One example per pure class

text.style: font: 7.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: and per pair (most transcripts, most even split); blue outline: nucleus from the DAPI channel; bar: colour used below, where each composite is

text.style: font: 7.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: coloured by the CIELAB midpoint of its parents' colours. (b) Share of each composite's 25 nearest pure neighbours (15-d latent space) that are its

text.style: font: 7.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: own two parents (left) or labelled random (right). Mean across pairs 0.392; top four pairs 66%–91%, against 0.286 by chance and 0.735 for a pure

text.style: font: 7.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: observation and its own class. In 4 of 5 pairs containing intranuclear the composite is absorbed into random (54%–81%). (c) Spearman correlation

text.style: font: 7.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: between a composite's mixing fraction and the share of its parent neighbours that are the second pattern. Scope: two-pattern mixtures of clean

text.style: font: 7.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif
